title: Completeness of Clause Splitting
statement: Let $C$ be a clause of literals over natural-number variables, let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $a:\mathbb{N}\to\{0,1\}$ be an assignment. Suppose every variable index occurring in $C$ is less than $n$, and $a$ satisfies $C$. Then there is an assignment $a':\mathbb{N}\to\{0,1\}$ that agrees with $a$ on every variable index below $n$ and satisfies the CNF formula obtained by splitting $C$ at cursor $n$.
hypotheses_covered: Every variable index in $C$ is less than $n$
replaced:
Let a clause $C$ have all variable indices below $n$ and let $a$ be an assignment
satisfying $C$. Then some assignment agreeing with $a$ below $n$ satisfies the
formula obtained by splitting $C$ at $n$.
